coverage: Pier & Point covers four sites on San Francisco's central waterfront: Mission Rock, Mission Bay, Pier 70 and Potrero Power Station. A parcel that is not in this data is outside coverage, not "no activity".

record.name: Chase Center Parking Garage (150 Warriors Way)
record.summary: This 469,726 sq ft, 9-story parking structure at 150 Warriors Way in Mission Bay South was built in 2009, per DataSF Assessor records -- roughly a decade before Chase Center opened next door -- and serves Chase Center and other Mission Bay South uses.
